worldcombat.skill.shadowbone.summary: Call up a spirit-wrapped bone from your side and hurl it at a distant foe: the bone guides itself to the target, deals non-contact damage on impact, and may rattle the target into a Defence drop of one stage. The only ranged member of the guard-breakers, reaching furthest but costing the most per throw.
worldcombat.skill.shadowbone.description: The thrown bone deals %1$s non-contact damage.
Range %1$s blocks, launch speed %2$s blocks/tick, %3$s block hit radius; the bone guides itself toward the target.
On a hit a %1$s chance lowers the target's Defence by %2$s stage; the spooked mark lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.shadowbone.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.shadowbone.growth.0: From level %1$s the bone rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.shadowbone.growth.1: From level %1$s the rattle chance rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.shadowbone.use.0: Hurl a spirit-wrapped bone from afar
worldcombat.skill.shadowbone.use.1: Open with the longest reach to soften a guard
worldcombat.skill.shadowbone.use.2: Leave a missed bone lying in the field for anyone
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of throwing. Larger values open from further away.
On: prefer targets that do not carry the guardbroken identity yet, to attach the rattle first. Off: treat it as an ordinary ranged attack.
